run_mae_pretrain_multinode: run multinode MAE pretraining on a SLURM cluster using submitit with configurable GPUs and nodes
submit_trainer_job: submit a MAE pretraining job to the SLURM scheduler via submitit AutoExecutor and print the job ID
parse_args_submitit: parse command-line arguments for MAE pretraining including ngpus, nodes, timeout, partition, and comment
setup_trainer_checkpoint: setup the Trainer class checkpoint method to requeue a pretraining job and resume from checkpoint.pth
setup_gpu_args: setup GPU arguments from submitit JobEnvironment including local rank, global rank, and world size
